ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area across approx 90% of visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) localized at distal tips and scattered in low-density speckles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the far-left and far-right distal tips. Sparse white pixel mottling is distributed across the dark field of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe intersection with a sharp interior vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the continuous trailing edge. Pronounced jagged peaks are visible on the upper-left margin and far-right distal extremity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the lower lateral margins transitioning to an irregular, slightly concave sweep along the trailing edges toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels forming irregular circular and semi-circular patterns at the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, roughly parallel vertical linear disruptions of light-intensity pixels located on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular white pixel regions at both distal tips representing localized surface trauma or accretions.
